proposal.summary: The reporter observed that a desktop client sometimes sends requests to an unknown address at startup and could not determine whether personal data was included.

AV.quote: sends requests to an address I do not recognize when it starts up.

AC.quote: sends requests to an address I do not recognize when it starts up.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request the reporter provide the desktop client name/version and capture (or allow you to capture) a network trace of the startup activity. Analyze the destination hostname/IP, TLS certificate (if any), request URLs and payloads to determine whether personal data is transmitted or if the behavior is expected; reproduce locally and, if confirmed problematic, identify the code path and prepare a remediation or explanation.

evidence_quotes.claim: Observed unexpected network requests at startup
evidence_quotes.quote: I noticed that your desktop client sometimes sends requests to an address I do not recognize when it starts up.

evidence_quotes.claim: Reporter unsure about presence of personal data
evidence_quotes.quote: I am not a security expert and I could not tell whether any personal data is included, but it seemed unusual, so I wanted to report it to your security team for review.
